jobs.description:
Application Deadline: 31 October 2026

Department: Operations (Engineering Services & Customer Support)

Location: Copenhagen

**Description

**At Factbird, we help manufacturers see what’s really happening on their lines—so they can make better, faster decisions. Our plug-and-play hardware and cloud platform turn live production data into clear insights, and we’re scaling fast across sites, teams, and countries.

We want to use AI wherever it can create meaningful value for Factbird: improving productivity, quality and the way people work.

Some of our teams use AI every day. Others have barely started. What we're missing is someone who finds where AI should go, builds it, and makes sure it sticks, then helps

everyone else get more out of what they already use, at the right cost. A patch here and a small workflow there won't cut it. You'll get into every department, find what should be built, and build it, while communicating priorities and tradeoffs to the team.

**

About the role

**This is a mid-career, professional-level position on Factbird’s career ladder and a hybrid role in terms of skills: technical enough to question how the tools work, hold your own with our engineers and build agents and automated flows yourself; organised enough to run a company-wide roadmap; and good with people, so what you build actually gets used.

It’s also a brand-new role, so there’s both the opportunity and the need for you to help define it. You’ll thrive here if you like owning a broad, loosely defined area and figuring out for yourself what matters most.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your first 90 days

• Own the setup and the bill. You take over the administration, licensing and cost management of our AI tools: connectors, MCP servers, permissions, workspace setup and caching that keeps cost and performance in check. From week one, you start building a clear picture of what we spend and where.

• Learn the company. You meet every department, learn their processes, and piece together how Factbird works as a whole

• Build the roadmap. You identify what AI should streamline, what’s competing for attention and what comes first based on where we can create the most value. You tell us what to tackle and what to drop.

• Run the first initiative. Take the top item off your roadmap and deliver it, start to finish

Beyond 90 days

• 
Pick the stack. You lead decisions on which AI platforms we keep, add or stop using, based on what works best for the company and its departments.

• 
Stay ahead. You keep up with what’s happening in AI and bring relevant ideas back to Factbird early.

• 
Deliver the roadmap, in two modes:

• 
Builder: where nobody has the time or know-how to start, you design and build the agents and automated flows yourself, hand them over, and drive the adoption so they actually get used

• 
Consultant: many people across Factbird already work with AI. You show them how to use it better and turn the best of their work into shared skills, prompts and agents that everyone can use.

• 
Keep it safe. You build appropriate quality checks into AI processes and own our AI usage guidelines and security practices together with Security & Compliance.

• 
Prove it. You measure the impact AI is having, good and bad, and can show cost against benefit

**About you

**You've spent the last few years in the details of AI. You don't have to be a developer, but your understanding is advanced:

• Not just "How is AI priced?" but “How can we reduce our API costs without compromising output quality?”

• Not just “What is an agent?” but “When should we build one, how should we build it, and when would a multi-agent setup make sense?”

• Not just “What is an LLM?” but “Which model fits this task, and when shouldn’t we use AI at all?”

• Not just “Is it safe?” but “What controls, permissions and human oversight does this agent need?”

• You've done it for real. You’ve taken a real business process and improved or automated it using AI.

• You know how to run a project**.** You don’t need to have held a project lead title. Consulting, operations, product or engineering experience all count, as long as they have made you great at planning and delivering.

• You prioritise clearly**.** You focus on where AI can create the most value, and you’re comfortable explaining why some ideas should not be pursued.

• You watch the money. Tokens, licenses, usage. You notice when spend is getting out of hand before anyone asks

• You make it simple. You can explain AI to anyone, train teams, and make complex tools feel approachable

• You don't wait for a roadmap. This role exists because someone needs to push us forward

Requirements

• 2+ years hands-on with AI in a business setting. Strong AI skills matter more than years of project leadership experience

• Experience with agents, automated flows, and AI tooling across more than one platform

• Experience planning and running projects, either as a project lead or in an adjacent role.

• A plus: experience measuring the cost, savings, or quality of AI work

• A technical degree or equivalent hands-on experience

• Clear communication in English with people of all levels of technical confidence.

• Based in or near Copenhagen, and able to work from our office

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it. Here's what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn't one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We'll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we'll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide gatherings & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what's next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We're proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**

We'd love to hear from you

**If this role feels like a match, we'd be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out at **crva@factbird.com

**_At Factbird, we believe that great work starts with people feeling respected, valued, and included. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

__All employment decisions at Factbird are made based on business needs, role requirements, and individual qualifications, without discrimination based on gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital or family status, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected under applicable European and local employment laws.

__We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make our teams stronger and our work better. We warmly encourage all qualified candidates to apply and to bring their whole selves to Factbird.

_Most machine learning never makes it to production. Your job is to make sure ours does. We are looking for an ML Engineer who turns models into reliable, maintained systems that construction companies actually use to make better decisions about their equipment and operations. You will work at the intersection of data science and software engineering, shaping how machine learning gets built, deployed, and improved at Trackunit.

**What’s in it for you?

Bring machine learning into everyday use. Turn models and experiments into reliable products that help customers make better decisions about their equipment and operations.

Shape how we build and run ML. Influence the tools, engineering practices, and deployment patterns that take solutions from an initial idea through to production and continuous improvement.

Work on interesting data challenges. Explore how equipment, sensor, and contextual data can support useful predictions and insights for the construction industry.

Build alongside people with different strengths. Collaborate with data scientists, data engineers, and product teams, combining scientific thinking with practical software engineering and customer understanding.

Develop your craft and your career. Join an international environment with knowledge sharing, feedback, and support for your personal and professional development.

**Who are you ideally?

**

• You have MLOps experience taking machine learning solutions into production and maintaining them beyond their initial release.

• You bring strong Python skills and solid software engineering practices, including testing, version control, code reviews, and CI/CD.

• Databricks expertise is a significant advantage.

• You ideally bring strong hands-on experience building ML workflows in Databricks, tracking experiments and managing models with MLflow, and deploying and monitoring models in production.

• You understand the ML lifecycle, from feature preparation and reproducible training to evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.

• You can work with data scientists to assess model performance, recognise issues such as data leakage and drift, and translate experimental code into maintainable systems.

• You have experience with cloud platforms and tools for orchestrating ML workflows and serving predictions. You can make sensible trade-offs between reliability, performance, and cost.

• You enjoy shaping solutions with others, explaining technical choices clearly, and connecting engineering decisions to customer needs.

• Experience training, tuning, and validating machine learning or deep learning models would be a plus.

• Experience with time series, sensor or geospatial data, or distributed processing would be a plus.

You don’t need experience with every tool or data type listed. If you bring strong engineering skills and enjoy making machine learning useful in practice, we’d like to hear from you.

**Our hiring process

****Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.

• A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role actually looks like day to day.

• Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.

• If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!

****Coming Together To Connect Construction

****We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products – it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

The Role

Our purpose

Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with offices in the UK, Norway and Germany, and supports over 400,000 users across Europe and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

How you'll make an impact

The Monetization team owns how customers buy and keep buying Planday: the checkout experience, subscription management, payments, and the systems behind them (our subscription and billing services, plus the integration layer to Zuora, Salesforce and Intercom). When a customer upgrades a plan, adds a product, or gets an invoice, that is our code path.

As a Full Stack Engineer at IC2, you will build and maintain features across that path, front end and back end, with support from engineers on the team. You will start with well-scoped pieces of customer-facing work and grow into owning features end to end.

You will join a cross-functional team of full stack engineers, a QA engineer, a UX researcher and a product manager. You will be paired with an engineer as your mentor from day one, and you will be expected to ask questions early and often: in a domain where mistakes are visible on customer invoices.

You will use AI coding tools every day, as the whole team does. We care less about how fast you can produce code and more about whether you can tell good output from plausible-looking output, and whether you can explain and defend what you ship.

What you'll do

• 
Create software: Build features across the stack: C# / .NET services and React + TypeScript front ends (We have one service in Java). Contribute to solution design discussions and take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.

• 
Work with AI tools, with judgement: Use AI coding assistants as part of normal delivery. Read, test and question what they produce. Never merge code you cannot explain line by line.

• 
Test software: Write and automate tests alongside your changes. Treat quality as part of the work rather than a later stage, with support from the team's QA engineer.

• 
Resolve issues: Help triage and fix development and production issues in the subscription, checkout and payments flows. Learn to trace a problem across services and third-party platforms, and communicate impact in business terms.

• 
Engineering standards : Learn and apply Planday's Engineering Standards. Take part in the Backend and Frontend Guilds to build a shared standard with engineers outside the team.

• 
Understand the domain : Build working knowledge of how plans, entitlements, invoices and payments fit together. In monetization, the business rules are the hard part; the code is often the easy part.

• 
Continuous improvement : Keep growing your knowledge of the technologies we use, and bring back what you learn to the team.

• 
Deliver in production : Ship your own changes through our CI/CD pipelines and watch how they behave once live.

Success looks like

• 
First three months: you ship small customer-facing changes to production with review support, you can explain the plan-change and invoicing paths in your own words, and you ask for help before you are stuck for a day.

• 
First twelve months: you own well-scoped features end to end across front end and back end, you catch your own errors before review does, you are a dependable second pair of eyes in code review, and you can explain the customer and revenue impact of what you build.

• 
Quality and pace: You deliver at a predictable, sustainable pace and flag risks and blockers early rather than at the deadline.

• 
Learning: You actively learn from your peers, act on feedback, and turn each review comment into something you no longer need told twice.

• 
Judgment with AI: You use AI tools to move faster without lowering the bar: you verify output, you confidently spot wrong suggestions, and you own everything you merge.

• 
Communication: You keep your team informed, write clearly in tickets and pull requests, and give Product accurate information so scope and timing decisions can be made.

What you'll bring with you

Critical competencies

• 
Growth mindset: You treat skill as something built, not fixed, and you go looking for feedback.

• 
Verification habit: You check things: you read the error, you run the test, you look at the data before you conclude.

• 
Problem-solving: You can break a problem down and describe your reasoning out loud, including the parts you are unsure about.

• 
Team player: You contribute to a collaborative team and are comfortable working closely with QA, UX and Product.

• 
Communication and time management: You are clear about progress, blockers and what you need.

• 
Care for the customer: You understand that billing and checkout bugs cost customers money and trust.

Experience we would like to see

We expect a junior engineer here to have roughly 1 to 2 years of professional experience, or equivalent evidence of building and shipping real software (internships, open-source, freelance).

• 
Working knowledge of one backend language, ideally C# / .NET

• 
Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, and a component framework such as React

• 
Comfortable with SQL and relational data

• 
Comfortable with Git, pull requests and code review

• 
Familiar with consuming and building REST APIs

• 
Some exposure to automated testing

• 
Hands-on use of AI coding tools (for example Claude, Codex, Copilot or Cursor) and an opinion about where they help and where they do not

• 
Nice to have: exposure to CI/CD, cloud platforms (we run on Azure), Redis, message-based integration between systems, or billing and subscription domains

You do not need to tick every line. If you can show us that you build things, verify your own work, and learn fast, we want to talk to you.

How we use AI in this hiring process

We use AI tools in our daily work, so we do not pretend otherwise when hiring.

• 
The technical interview: it runs in two halves. First you read and review code with your AI tools closed, so we can see how you read. Then you open your usual tools and build, as you would on the job. We will tell you exactly when the switch happens.

• 
What we assess: your reasoning, your ability to explain and defend code (including code that a tool wrote), and your judgement about when to trust output. Using AI is not a problem; being unable to explain your work is.

At Planday, we offer you

• 
Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

• 
On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

• 
Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us

• 
Flexible remote work

• 
Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

• 
Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

• 
Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

**About Sedna

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising global trade, serving as the North Star for businesses navigating the complexities of international commerce. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming global trade.

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

**About The Role

**As an Account Director at Sedna, you'll carry a blended number: winning new logos across the commodities and owner/operator/charterer segments, and expanding our relationships with the key customers already in your portfolio.

This is a senior, strategic sales position. On the new business side, you'll run the full cycle - from prospecting through to close - bringing new shipping and trading companies onto Sedna's platform. On the account side, you'll act as a trusted advisor to our most important existing customers, deepening engagement and identifying new opportunities for expansion. Either way, you're driving revenue growth with the autonomy and accountability of a founder, and helping customers unlock the full potential of Sedna's AI-powered platform.

Working in a fast-growth company means that no day is ever the same! But here are the main responsibilities and tasks you'll undertake while working for us:

Industry and product knowledge

• Developing deep knowledge of the commodities, owner, operator and charterer segments within maritime to build credibility and tailor your approach to each prospect's and customer's unique needs.

• Increasing your expertise in Sedna's product, understanding its core features, capabilities and how it addresses challenges faced by our largest customers.

• Leveraging case studies and success stories from current clients to provide insights and strategies that improve outcomes for prospects and customers alike.

• Using Sedna's platform extensively to ensure familiarity with its features, value propositions and potential use cases for different parts of a business.

New business development

• Building and qualifying a pipeline of high-potential new-logo prospects across the commodities and owner/operator/charterer segments.

• Researching and prioritising target accounts based on size, tech stack and operational complexity.

• Running discovery conversations and tailored demos that connect a prospect's operational challenges to Sedna's platform capabilities.

• Leading the full sales cycle for new business - scoping, negotiation and close - with commercial rigour and customer-centricity.

• Representing Sedna at relevant international maritime events to build visibility and network with potential buyers.

• Ensuring a smooth handover to onboarding and success teams so new customers experience immediate value.

Account strategy and growth

• Building and executing account strategies for key customers to ensure sustained value and expansion of Sedna's footprint.

• Engaging with senior stakeholders across departments within your accounts to identify new opportunities for growth, leveraging existing relationships to introduce additional Sedna solutions.

• Developing a deep understanding of your customers' strategic goals and aligning Sedna's offerings to help them achieve long-term success.

• Ensuring a thorough understanding of each customer's internal workflows and how Sedna can be further integrated to optimise efficiency.

Driving growth and expansion

• Identifying upsell opportunities within your existing accounts by understanding customers' evolving needs and challenges.

• Working alongside the solutions consultancy team to lead product demonstrations and scoping sessions to highlight the benefits of expanding Sedna's use across different teams and departments.

• Collaborating with the Customer Success, Product and Implementation teams to facilitate smooth rollouts and ensure successful adoption of expanded services.

• Managing contract renewals and expansions, ensuring that all commercial terms are aligned with your growth targets and the customer's needs.

• Working with RevOps and Finance to ensure company best practices are followed across new business, renewals and expansions.

Stakeholder engagement

• Mapping out key decision-makers within prospects and existing accounts and establishing strong, trusted relationships with them.

• Acting as the main point of contact for senior stakeholders and ensuring Sedna is viewed as a strategic partner, not just a vendor.

• Hosting regular business reviews and strategic planning sessions with key accounts to track progress, uncover opportunities and ensure ongoing success.

Continuous improvement

• Contributing and maintaining data for effective forecasting across both new business and existing accounts.

• Contributing to the Product, Marketing, Success and other teams to help Sedna be a better company and platform, and in turn, make a bigger impact on our customers.

• Reflecting on successes and failures, and making improvements to your ways of working as a result.

**About You

**Proven, direct management of client relations at C-suite level is essential - this is a senior role and requires building and maintaining strong, strategic relationships with both prospects and existing customers from day one.

At Sedna, we believe it's your skills and attributes that ultimately make you successful in a role. Here's what we're looking for:

• Experience - a minimum of 10 years' experience in client-facing, sales or account management roles, with a proven track record of both winning new logos and growing large strategic accounts. Shipping or maritime industry experience is highly valued - we're looking for someone who already understands our customers' world.

• Self motivated - you are motivated to achieve in this role because of your enthusiasm - you relish pressure from others but don't need it to succeed.

• Concise communicator - you can articulate a message in a calm, clear, focused way. You hold your audience's attention, and they retain what you tell them. Equally, you actively listen and interpret what your audience tells you.

• Emotionally intelligent - you understand, use and control your emotions in positive ways, to relieve stress, empathise with others, overcome challenges, and diffuse conflict.

• Technical aptitude - you keep abreast with modern technologies and have the ability to learn and master them quickly.

• Coachability - you have the ability to adapt and improve as required.

**Our Values

**Finally, culture is important to us, so we also look for candidates who share our values:

**Stay Ahead, Stay Agile

**

• We don’t just adapt-we anticipate change and act with confidence.

• Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.

• We embrace challenges as opportunities and remain resilient under pressure.

• By staying open to new ideas and ways of working, we lead the future.

**Execute With Focus

**

• We turn strategy into action, delivering measurable results that matter.

• Every initiative counts-discipline and ownership drive business impact.

• We make smart decisions with speed, balancing pace and precision.

• Clear priorities keep us focused on what moves the needle.

**Work Together, Win Together

**

• Collaboration is our superpower-we succeed as one team, internally and with customers.

• We co-create solutions, seek feedback, and build the future of the OS together.

• Strong relationships are built on trust, respect, and shared goals.

• By aligning across teams and with customers, we unlock greater impact.

jobs.occupation: Chauffør til fælgværksted i Søborg – Hjulfix / Driver for rim workshop in Søborg – Hjulfix
jobs.description:
Vil du have et job, hvor du er på farten hver dag og møder kunderne ansigt til ansigt? Hos Hjulfix i Søborg søger vi en stabil og serviceminded chauffør, der står for afhentning og levering af hjul og fælge hos vores kunder. Det er primært værksteder, bilforhandlere og skadecentre i Storkøbenhavn og på Sjælland.

Hos Hjulfix kommer du til at arbejde tæt sammen med vores værksted for reparation af fælge i Søborg, hvor vi renoverer, retter og lakerer omkring 10.000 fælge om året. Du bliver bindeleddet mellem kunderne og værkstedet, så din indsats har stor betydning for, at fælgene kommer sikkert frem og tilbage til tiden.

Dine opgaver

• 
Afhente og levere hjul og fælge hos værksteder og skadecentre i Storkøbenhavn og på Sjælland

• 
Planlægge din rute sammen med værkstedet, så kunderne får deres fælge til aftalt tid

• 
Håndtere og sikre hjul og fælge forsvarligt under transport

• 
Have dialog med kunderne og sikre god service ved hver levering

• 
Hjælpe til i værkstedet, når du er tilbage fra køreturen, fx med af- og påmontering og klargøring

Vi forventer, at du

• 
Har kørekort kategori B (almindelig bil)

• 
Er vant til at køre varebil og kender trafikken i Storkøbenhavn

• 
Er mødestabil, pligtopfyldende og kan arbejde selvstændigt

• 
Taler dansk eller engelsk (gerne begge dele)

• 
Er serviceminded og giver gerne en hånd med, hvor der er brug for det

Vi tilbyder

• 
Fast fuldtidsstilling, mandag–fredag

• 
Mulighed for oplæring i forskellige opgaver i værkstedet, og din løn følger med, efterhånden som du lærer nye færdigheder

• 
En helt ny varebil, som bliver din til kørslen

• 
Varierede dage, hvor du starter med morgenens køretur, og når du er tilbage, hjælper du til med opgaver i værkstedet

• 
En virksomhed i vækst med et godt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø

Om Hjulfix
Hjulfix er specialister i renovering af alufælge, fælgopretning, lakering og diamond cut. Vi servicerer værksteder, forhandlere og private kunder i hele Danmark fra vores værksted på Gladsaxe Møllevej 21 i Søborg.

Ansøgning
Send en kort ansøgning og dit CV til job@hjulfix.dk. Vi holder samtaler løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål, kan du ringe til Adrian på 42 46 27 75.

English version: Driver for rim workshop in Søborg – Hjulfix

Hjulfix in Søborg is looking for a reliable, service-minded driver to pick up and deliver wheels and rims for our customers. They are mainly garages, car dealers and body shops in Greater Copenhagen and on Zealand. Our workshop repairs, straightens and refinishes around 10,000 rims a year, and you'll be the link between our customers and the workshop.

Your tasks

• 
Pick up and deliver wheels and rims across Greater Copenhagen and Zealand

• 
Plan your route with the workshop so customers get their rims on time

• 
Handle and secure wheels and rims safely during transport

• 
Talk with customers and make sure every delivery goes smoothly

• 
Help out in the workshop when you're back from your run

We expect you to

• 
Hold a category B driving licence

• 
Be used to driving a van and know Copenhagen traffic

• 
Be reliable, punctual and able to work independently

• 
Speak English or Danish (both is a plus)

• 
Be service-minded and happy to lend a hand

We offer

• 
A permanent full-time job, Monday–Friday

• 
Training in different tasks in the workshop, with your salary growing as you learn new skills

• 
A brand-new van for your driving

• 
Varied days: you start with the morning run, and once you're back you help out with tasks in the workshop

• 
A growing company with a good, informal atmosphere

How to apply
Send a short application and your CV to job@hjulfix.dk. We interview on a rolling basis. For questions, call Adrian on +45 42 46 27 75.

jobs.occupation: Robot Engineer: Keep the fleet in known-good condition: preventive maintenance, calibration, inspection and bring-up.
jobs.description:
About the role

Our robots do real work every day, and this role keeps them in known-good condition. You will own preventive maintenance, calibration and inspection across the fleet, with the standing to make the call on whether a robot goes out. It's a hands-on, high-trust role at the heart of the operation.

What you'll do

• 
Perform preventive maintenance and service: cabling, fasteners, wear parts, mechanical condition

• 
Run calibration as a routine, including the teleoperation rig

• 
Own the inspection routine and its records, so trends stay visible

• 
Handle new-platform and new-unit bring-up

• 
Communicate with the robot vendor to troubleshoot problems

• 
Make the final call on whether a robot is fit for operation

• 
Work closely with the engineering teams who depend on the fleet being ready

What we look for

Some combination of the following:

• 
Hands-on electromechanical service experience on real equipment

• 
A methodical, documenting work style — behaviour changes should be traceable to a specific service

• 
Comfort with Linux basics, SSH and networks

• 
The professional confidence to keep quality steady, even under schedule pressure

Tools you'll work with

• 
Standard electromechanical service tooling

• 
Linux CLI / SSH for diagnostics and calibration routines

• 
Version-controlled service logs and inspection records

• 
CAD modelling and 3D printing

Bonus experience

• 
Robotics or automation background

• 
Sensor mounting, fixtures, light fabrication

• 
Electrical diagnosis: harnesses, connectors, power

• 
Field service experience

•

jobs.occupation: Physical AI Senior - Manipulation: Drive our autonomous manipulation effort end to end: policy stack, data, evaluation discipline and architecture
jobs.description:
About the role

Robots that restock shelves autonomously, at a reliability level a customer signs off on — that's the mission of this role. You will lead our autonomous manipulation effort end to end: the policy stack, the data behind it, the evaluation discipline that keeps the numbers honest, and the architectural direction of the whole track. You'll work with experienced VLA engineers who are ready to go deeper with the right technical lead.

What you'll do

• 
Own the manipulation policy stack from data collection through training to on-robot evaluation

• 
Track frontier AI manipulation research, test it on our hardware, and decide what to adopt, fine-tune, or build

•

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral position in computational modeling of visual perception
jobs.description:
The Department of Psychology, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a fully funded postdoctoral position in computational modeling of visual perception. The position is available for up to 36 months and is part of a project led by Dr. Gregory Scott Francis that is supported by the SDU Department of Psychology. The starting date is March 15, 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Research environment

The postdoc will be affiliated with the Research Unit of Health and Cognitive Psychology. The position is at the SDU Esbjerg campus but will also involve interaction with staff at the SDU Odense campus. 

Project description

A basic process of the visual system is to monitor the location and characteristics of objects in a scene, and the multiple object tracking (MOT) paradigm has identified many fundamental aspects of this process. With a rich literature of empirical results, this paradigm is ready for theoretical development, which this project intends to pursue using an integrate-and-fire neural network model known as LAMINART. A key aspect of the model is the ability to select/segment visual objects, which may explain how people can (seemingly) effortlessly track multiple objects in a dynamic visual scene. 

The successful candidate will be required to design, program and analyze an integrate-and-fire neural network model of visual perception. Good programming (Python) skills are required along with a good understanding of empirical methods and ways to connect empirical findings with model behavior. The position also involves teaching duties.

The project involves collaboration with Prof. Søren Krogh Andersen, also at SDU.

Qualifications

Ideally, applicants for the position should satisfy the following requirements:

• 
PhD level in psychology, cognitive (neuro)science, vision science, or a related field

• 
Research experience as evidenced by conference contributions and peer-reviewed journal articles in a field related to the offered position

• 
Expertise in visual attention and perception

• 
Strong analytical skills, including the ability to design, implement, and analyze complex experiments

• 
Be willing and able to teach for the Department of Psychology

• 
Prior experience with neural network modeling is a plus

• 
Prior experience with cognitive modelling is a plus

• 
Good command of statistics

• 
Good command of Python (or similar programming languages and a willingness to learn)

• 
Very good command of the English language in spoken and written form

• 
Some knowledge of the Danish language is a plus

Candidates who are about to obtain these qualifications are also encouraged to apply. 

Contact information

For further information about the position, please contact Dr. Greg Francis, SDU (email: gfrancis@health.sdu.dk; phone: +45 65 50 16 98), or Professor Søren Krogh Andersen (email: skandersen@health.sdu.dk; phone: +45 65 50 49 57)

Application deadline

The application deadline is November 08, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. CET.

Salary and terms of employment

The base salary for a postdoctoral researcher is DKK 36,877.42, with an additional job structure supplement of DKK 5,230.75. This brings the total monthly salary to DKK 42,108.16.

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application

Applications must be in English and submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". 

Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

• 
A letter of motivation (max. 1 page)

• 
A detailed CV

• 
Master and PhD degree certificates, if available

• 
A complete and numbered list of publications 

• 
Three scientific publications (or preprints) considered to be most important for the advertised position (please note that one file per publication must be submitted)

• 
Contact details of at least two university supervisors or employers who can provide references

If you experience technical problems, you must contact hcm-support@sdu.dk.

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application. 

Incomplete applications and applications received after the application deadline will not be considered. 

Shortlisting of applications may be used in the initial selection process.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

Who We Are

At Ø12, we serve exceptional food and coffee from breakfast through lunch in a warm, high-energy environment where both guests and staff feel welcome. With three busy locations, we’re driven by teamwork, structure, and a shared commitment to doing things well.

We’re looking for a dedicated and reliable dishwasher to join our team and help keep our kitchen running smoothly.

What You Can Expect From Us

Are you an experienced and motivated OT Security Architect and do you want to leave your mark on the global energy industry? If so, we want to hear from you!

Your position

In your new position as OT Security Architect in the Renewables division, you will be a valuable member of the OT Security Team, whose mission is to ensure excellent OT security deliveries on large-scale EPC substation projects. You will have the chance to take the architectural lead and help shape a collaborative team culture built on expertise and knowledge-sharing. Above all, your work will make a real difference to the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be at one of our offices in either Esbjerg, Aarhus or Copenhagen. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel 10–30 days per year.

“Every day, we help enable the green energy transition by building secure, resilient OT solutions that ensure renewable energy assets operate safely and reliably.” - OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.

Your tasks & responsibilities

In our Renewables division, we have major EPC projects in the pipeline for both short- and long-term operations. As an OT Security Architect, you will take the architectural lead and support all OT Security areas across the EPC substation projects.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

• Contributing to the implementation of industry-accepted good practice and required Cyber/OT Security architecture at solution level, typically based on standards such as IEC 62443, ISO 27001, and NIS

• Helping define products and standards relevant to OT Security and infrastructure

• Hands-on experience with cybersecurity audits and compliance frameworks, including ISO 27001, Critical Infrastructure regulations, and IEC 62443

• Reviewing requirements/ITT packages and providing input to tenders consisting of calculations, solutions, descriptions, clarifications, and reservations

• Taking on an advisory or active role in infrastructure, identity access management, or logging/event-based activities

• Being responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing FAT, SAT, and SIT activities to ensure successful system delivery and integration

• Implementing customer-specific Cyber/OT Security requirements in substation design for multiple systems and subsystems, such as SCADA, low-voltage, HVAC, Auxiliary Control and Monitoring System, etc.

Crucial to this position is your ability to take ownership of project deliverables and coordinate OT Security deadlines with internal and external stakeholders. You should thrive in a leading role where your skills, collaboration, and structured approach help ensure that requirements are met.

Your profile & qualifications

You are a team player who enjoys leading projects and working with stakeholders to align on timing, scope, and objectives. You know when technical expertise should be brought in to support delivery. To us, this means that you have a structured and solution-oriented approach, the ability to influence stakeholders, and the dedication to see tasks through to completion.

You will be part of a team of six colleagues that values quality, attention to detail, and a flexible working environment. We are sociable, helpful, and open to input, and we work in a dedicated, structured, and execution-focused way while respecting the agility that is a natural part of our core tasks. We want the same from you.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

• A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in OT Security from a similar position

• A Tech Lead mentality – we are not seeking an extreme subject matter expert, but a well-rounded colleague who can work through heavily structured large projects involving many stakeholders

• The ability to know when additional technical specialists or resources are needed to complete a project

• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English

• Experience working in complex engineering projects, as well as project and stakeholder management, is an advantage

If you have any questions, you are more than welcome to contact OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.
